in_sanskrit.name: Istiyak
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है God's promise
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Istiyak एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Istiyak is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'ist' meaning 'it' and 'yak' meaning 'that'. It signifies a divine promise or commitment from the gods. In Hindu mythology, Istiyak is believed to be a name given to a child born after a vow or prayer is fulfilled.
